title: fix(plugin-charts): scatter grid honours the spec axis showGridLines
body:
Fixes #9792
Clause-②: no

## What

The scatter branch of `AdvancedChartImpl` drew its grid from a hard-coded `CartesianGrid vertical={false}` literal. It now spreads the same derived `gridProps` the bar/line/area and horizontal-bar branches spread. So a spec `showGridLines` declared on either scatter axis is honoured: `yAxis.showGridLines: false` removes the horizontal lines, and `xAxis.showGridLines: true` adds vertical ones.

## Premise re-derivation (the card's load-bearing claim, measured here, not taken from the card)

- `gridProps` is derived in the component body before any `chartType` branch returns, so it is already in scope in the scatter branch. Nothing was hoisted or re-derived.
- It reads `xAxisSpec` (the `xAxis` prop) and `primaryY` (`yAxes[0]`). These are the same two objects the scatter axes read since objectui#9675: `numericAxisSpecProps(xAxisSpec, ...)` on X and `yAxisSpecProps(primaryY)` on Y. There is no stale or second `xAxis` object.
- `normalizeAxis` copies `showGridLines` only when it is a boolean and fills no default. So with no axis `showGridLines`, `gridProps` evaluates to `vertical: false` (`undefined === true`) and `horizontal: true` (`undefined !== false`). That is the literal's `vertical={false}` plus recharts' own default `horizontal`.
- **Byte-level proof:** a throwaway probe rendered the scatter three ways and serialised the `g.recharts-cartesian-grid` group's outerHTML: (a) no axes, (b) `xAxis: { format }` only, (c) `yAxes: [{ min: 0 }]` only. It did this once on the unfixed tree and once on the fixed tree. `cmp` reports the two dumps identical (2621 bytes each). The probe file was deleted and is not committed.

## Tests

New `packages/plugin-charts/src/AdvancedChartImpl.scatterGridLines-9792.test.tsx` renders the real `AdvancedChartImpl` with the same `ResponsiveContainer` box mock the objectui#9675 and objectui#7396 scatter files use:

1. Control: with no axis declaring the key, horizontal lines are present and there are 0 vertical lines. This passes on the defect and on the fix.
2. With `yAxes[0].showGridLines: false`: 0 horizontal lines.
3. With `xAxis.showGridLines: true`: vertical lines are present and horizontal lines are kept.

**Ablation.** Run after committing the fix (head `32fd97245`). `ablation-replace.mjs` put the literal back (anchor hit 1 time, blob `ef9b7eac75e5` became `16bc459a9baf`). Result: `Tests 2 failed | 1 passed (3)`, with case 2 and case 3 red and the control green. The restore was verified: the blob equals the HEAD blob and `git diff HEAD` is empty. The first attempt used an anchor that missed; the tool refused it and ran nothing.
